units.source_text: 我所指望留传的不是你。”

en.t: You are not the one I hope will carry it on.

units.source_text: 夕雾想问他所指望的是谁，忽然一个孩子在睡梦中哭起来，把他惊醒了。

en.t: Yugiri was about to ask whom he did mean, when suddenly a child began crying in its sleep and woke him with a start.

units.source_text: 这孩子哭得很厉害，乳汁都吐出了。

en.t: The child cried violently and even spat up its milk.

units.source_text: 因此乳母也起身，人声嘈杂起来，云居雁也拿着灯来了。

en.t: So the nurse got up too, voices rose in confusion, and Kumoinokari came in carrying a lamp.

units.source_text: 她把头发夹在耳上，殷勤地逗哄他，抱着他坐下。

en.t: She tucked her hair behind her ears, gently coaxed and soothed him, and sat down holding him in her arms.

units.source_text: 她近来很肥胖，此时便撩开她那丰腴的酥胸来，给孩子喂奶。

en.t: She had grown quite plump of late, and now she opened her full, soft breast to nurse the child.

units.source_text: 这孩子也长得很漂亮。

en.t: This child too was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 母亲的乳房虽然洁白可爱，但吮不出乳汁来，只是给他含着，借以慰情而已。

en.t: Though the mother's breast was white and lovely, no milk could be drawn from it; she merely let him hold it in his mouth to comfort him.

units.source_text: 夕雾也走过来看，问道：“怎么样了？”

en.t: Yugiri also came over to look and asked, "How is he?"

units.source_text: 便叫人拿些米来撒在地上，以驱除梦魔。

en.t: Then he had someone bring some rice and scatter it on the floor to drive away the nightmare spirit.

units.source_text: 一时室中骚乱，夕雾梦中的哀情也便消失了。

en.t: For a while the room was in an uproar, and the sorrow from Yugiri's dream vanished as well.

units.source_text: 云居雁对他说道：“这孩子好像有病了。

en.t: Kumoinokari said to him, "The child seems to be ill.

units.source_text: 你醉心于那边的新鲜花样，深夜回来还要赏月，把格子门打开，那些鬼怪便混进来作祟了。”

en.t: You were so taken with those novel charms over there that, coming home late at night, you still opened the lattice to admire the moon, and those spirits slipped in to make mischief."

units.source_text: 她恨恨地说，那娇嗔之相实甚可爱。

en.t: She spoke resentfully, and her pouting, coquettish expression was truly charming.

units.source_text: 夕雾笑道：“我万万想不到带了鬼怪进来呢！

en.t: Yugiri laughed and said, "I never imagined I had brought spirits in with me.

units.source_text: 对啊，我倘不开格子门，没有通路，鬼怪便进不来了。

en.t: Yes, of course: if I had not opened the lattice, there would have been no path, and the spirits could not have entered.

units.source_text: 你毕竟是许多孩子的妈妈，想得周到，说话很有点道理嘛。”

en.t: After all, you are the mother of many children; you think carefully, and what you say does make some sense."

units.source_text: 说时，盯着云居雁看，看得云居雁不好意思了。

en.t: As he spoke, he gazed steadily at Kumoinokari, until she grew embarrassed under his stare.

units.source_text: 她说：“罢了，里面去吧。

en.t: She said, "Enough now; let us go inside.

units.source_text: 我这样子怪难看的……”

en.t: I must look terribly unsightly like this..."

units.source_text: 在明亮的灯光下，她那羞答答的样子实甚可爱。

en.t: In the bright lamplight, her shy, bashful manner was truly lovely.

units.source_text: 小公子的确身体不大好，一直啼哭，直到天亮。

en.t: The young lord was indeed not well, and he went on crying until dawn.
